# S62A - Cut the load files down to a few cases
Keeps only the chosen cases (and everything linked to them) in SCHEMA/latest, DOCUMENTS/latest and USERS,
so the LOAD pipelines load just those cases. A full copy of each folder is saved first, so you can restore it.

# Parameters
CASE_REFS = ["S62A/2022/5000001", "S62A/2024/0032"]   # MPA (7-digit) or original Horizon refs both work

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = None      # optional override; leave None to auto-detect from the workspace
FOLDERS = {
    "SCHEMA":    "OUTPUT/SCHEMA/latest",
    "DOCUMENTS": "OUTPUT/DOCUMENTS/latest",
    "USERS":     "OUTPUT/USERS",
}
BACKUP_ROOT = "OUTPUT/SUBSET_BACKUP"   # full copies go here before anything is cut
DRY_RUN     = False                    # True = show what would be kept, change nothing
LOCAL_DIRS  = None                     # testing only: {"SCHEMA": "/path", "DOCUMENTS": "/path", "USERS": "/path"}

# Integrity check on the cut-down set (every FK must point at a kept row)
ALL = {**{k[:-4]: v for k, v in O.items()}, **{k[:-4]: v for k, v in OD.items()}}
if user_file:
    ALL["User"] = out["USERS"][user_file]
FKS = [("S62aDates", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("S62aFees", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("S62aEvent", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"),
       ("S62aResidential", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("S62aNonResidential", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"),
       ("S62aToApplicant", "s62aId", "S62aCase"), ("S62aToApplicant", "contactId", "Contact"),
       ("S62aToApplicant", "organisationId", "Organisation"), ("ApplicationNote", "s62aId", "S62aCase"),
       ("S62aCaseInspector", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("S62aVehicleParking", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"),
       ("S62aResidentialHousing", "s62aResidentialId", "S62aResidential"),
       ("S62aNonResidentialFloorspace", "s62aNonResidentialId", "S62aNonResidential"),
       ("S62aNonResidentialFloorspaceArea", "s62aFloorspaceEntryId", "S62aNonResidentialFloorspace"),
       ("S62aCase", "siteAddressId", "Address"), ("S62aCase", "lpaContactId", "Contact"),
       ("Contact", "addressId", "Address"), ("Organisation", "addressId", "Address"),
       ("Folder", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("Folder", "parentFolderId", "Folder"),
       ("Document", "s62aCaseId", "S62aCase"), ("Document", "folderId", "Folder")]
if user_file:
    FKS += [("S62aCase", c, "User") for c in ["assessorInspectorId", "caseOfficerId", "planningOfficerId", "readerId"]]
    FKS += [("S62aCaseInspector", "userId", "User"), ("ApplicationNote", "userId", "User")]
problems = []
for child, col, parent in FKS:
    if child in ALL and parent in ALL and col in ALL[child].columns and len(ALL[child]):
        vals = ALL[child][col]
        vals = vals[vals != ""]
        orphans = int((~vals.isin(set(ALL[parent]["id"]))).sum())
        if orphans:
            problems.append(f"{child}.{col} -> {parent}: {orphans}")
print("Integrity:", "OK" if not problems else problems)

summary = pd.DataFrame(
    [{"folder": key, "file": name, "before": len(data[key][name]), "after": len(df)}
     for key, files in out.items() for name, df in files.items()]
).sort_values(["folder", "file"])
print(summary.to_string(index=False))
assert not problems, "Fix the orphans above before writing"
